# M1-12 — AI Usage Register Setup & Initial Entries

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-medium`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Create the AI Usage Register with minimum fields: Date, Student, Tool, Engineering task, AI contribution, Verification, Decision, Issues found
- [ ] Record every material AI-assisted contribution made during M1 (drafting registers, requirements phrasing, research support, etc.)
- [ ] For each entry, document how the AI output was verified, and note anything rejected or changed
- [ ] Confirm no confidential/sensitive data was exposed to external AI tools
- [ ] Prepare one verified example each team member can individually defend
- [ ] Integrate the register into PED v1.0

## Acceptance Criteria
- Register uses all required minimum fields for every entry.
- At least one entry per team member, with genuine verification detail (not "AI generated it").
- Each student can explain, in their own words, what they verified/rejected/changed for at least one entry.
